text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby appropriated, out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for public works as mentioned hereunder, and
for other purposes of the Insular Government.
NON-CHRISTIAN AND SPECIAL PROVINCES.
For the construction, improvement, and extension of telephone lines
For aid to local governments in the construction of a simple type of sanitary public market
25,000.00
For the construction and improvement of public buildings and for other purposes..
30,000.00
For the maintenance and repair of those portions of the Manila North road declared as first-class road which
traverse territory of the Mountain Province
70,000.00
For the construction, improvement, and maintenance of trails, roads, and bridges in the non-Christian and
special provinces
500,000.00
For the construction, reconstruction, improvement, investigations, and surveys of ports, wharves, piers,
retaining walls, jetties, dams, and dredgings in the non-Christian and special provinces
100,000.00
For the construction, improvement, and maintenance of irrigation systems in the Mountain Province
8,000.00
BUREAU OF EDUCATION.
For the construction of normal schools and the purchase of grounds for the same....

300,000.00
For Insular aid in the construction of buildings for central, barrio, interme diate, and agricultural schools
250,000.00
For aid in the construction of provincial schools
200,000.00
For permanent improvements in the Central Agricultural School of Luzon at Muñoz, Nueva Ecija
For an irrigation system in the Central Agricultural School of Luzon at Muiioz, Nueva Ecija, in three annual
allotments, second allotment
20,000.00
For the purchase, survey, and registration of land and the construction, improvement, and maintenance of
buildings for agricultural schools and dormitories, in the non-Christian and special provinces..
100,000.00
For the construction of a high school building in the city of Manila, providing said city appropriate on its part
sufficient funds to complete said construction
100,000.00
BUREAU OF HEALTH.
To complete the construction of the insane ward at San Lazaro Hospital
40,000.00
To be added to the sum of P7,500 appropriated in the year 1917 for the hospital at Tacloban, Leyte: Provided,
That both sums shall be used for the construction of a new building or for the improvement of the one now
existing, including the purchase of land
10,000.00
For the purchase, survey and registration of land, improvement of the grounds, and construction,
improvement, and maintenance of the buildings of the hospitals in the non-Christian and special provinces
30,000.00
To reimburse the Province of Bulacan for the money expended for improvements of the Sibul baths and for
the payment of the land expropriated for this purpose
26,000.00

BUREAU OF CUSTOMS.
To improve the facilities for loading and discharging cargo and for the safe keeping of the merchandise at the
ports of entry
75,000.00
BUREAU OF AGRICULTURE.
For the construction of temporary buildings, sheds, fences, and coops
25,000.00
BUREAU OF FORESTRY.
For the construction of six forestry stations
5,000.00
For the construction of a road from the College of Agriculture to the Forestry School at Los Baños
10,000.00
BUREAU OF LANDS.
For the maintenance, alteration, and repair of the irrigation systems on the friar estates
33,900.00
BUREAU OF PUBLIC WORKS.
For the construction, improvement, and, where necessary, for the maintenance of roads and bridges in such
regularly organized provinces as shall accept the provisions of Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and fifty-two,
or which by a resolution of the provincial board shall guarantee by continuing annual appropriations the
establishment of such a system of maintenance as may be necessary in the opinion of the Director of Public
Works, on all first-class roads at present constructed or which in the future may be constructed, and are so
declared by the Director of Public Works, to be apportioned in proportion to the number of cedulas sold in
each province in the year 1917..................
For the construction, improvement, and, where necessary, the maintenance of roads and bridges in the
provinces which by resolution of the provincial board shall guarantee by continuing annual appropriations the
establishment of such a system of maintenance as may be necessary in the judgment of the Director of Public
Works on all first-class roads now constructed or which may be constructed in the future and declared as such
by the Director of Public Works
1,500,000.00
Provided, That a sum not to exceed P20,000 shall be set aside for the construction of a road between Sibul and
Biak-na-bato, subject to the condition that the Province of Bulacan, or the municipality of San Miguel, or
both, appropriate on their part sufficient funds to complete said construction.

For contribution to the city of Manila toward the construction of a bridge across the Pasig River which shall
bear the name of William Atkinson Jones, of Virginia, in recognition of his services on behalf of the Filipino
people, on the condition that said city shall on its part appropriate sufficient funds to complete the constraction
500,000.00
For the construction, improvement, and, where necessary, for the maintenance of interprovincial roads and
bridges, including roads and bridges connecting one coast with another in the same province, between the
provinces which by resolution of the provincial board shall guarantee by continuing annual appropriations the
establishment of such a system of maintenance as may be necessary in the judgment of the Director of Public
Works on all first class roads now constructed or which may be constructed in the future and declared as such
by the Director of Public Works
For the construction, repair, reconstruction, improvement, investigations, and surveys of ports, wharves, piers,
retaining walls, jetties, dams, and for dredgings, in the different districts of the Archipelago, including the
purchase of necessary equipment, and the continuation of wharves and other improvements projected by
former laws..
600,000.00
Provided, That subject to the approval of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications and with such
security as the same may require, material derived from dredging may be used for filling in private property at
the request of any landowner, upon the condition that the cost thereof shall be paid by the owner of the land in
annual payments not to extend over more than five years.
For the drilling of artesian wells, including the purchase of necessary equipment, and for the study and
construction of Insular, provincial, and municipal systems of waterworks, and for the investigation,
construction, reconstruction, and extension of baths and other sanitary improvements for the development and
exploitation of properly tested and approved mineral springs in places of public resort, whenever the
provinces and municipalities concerned shall adopt resolutions for the appropriation of funds covering the cost
of one-third part of the work
650,000.00
Provided, That the funds appropriated by provinces and municipalities to cover the cost of one-third part of
the work shall be covered into the Insular Treasury when the Director of Public Works shall have paid the cost
thereof: And provided, further, That any municipality or province which by virtue of the provisions of this Act
shall incur the expense of an artesian well resulting in a failure, shall have the amounts expended returned to
it: And provided, finally, That the amount allotted to a municipality or province as Insular aid shall in no case
exceed the sum of twenty-five thousand pesos.
For the investigation, survey, construction, reconstruction, and improvement of irrigation systems, including
the purchase of the necessary land and equipment
Provided, That the use of water for private land shall be subject only to such rules and regulations as may be
prescribed by the Irrigation Council, the provisions of Acts Numbered 1854, 2152, and 2652 to the contrary

notwithstanding.
For such expenses as may be authorized while this Act is in force and effect, for the construction of a building
for the use of the Legislature, for the proposed offices and rooms at Malacañan Palace, for a post-office
building, for an arts and trades school, and for a nurses' dormitory for the General Hospital; for other Insular
buildings of minor importance, not to exceed in each case twenty-five thousand pesos, and for the purchase
and improvement of the necessary land
2,000,000.00
For the maintenance, alteration, and repair of public buildings
300,000.00
For the expenses in the investigation of applications for irrigation or water rights and river control
investigations submitted to the Irrigation Council
25,000.00
For the maintenance of ports and esteros, including equipment
325,000.00
For the maintenance of the Pasig River from the Jones Bridge to the Laguna de Bay
35,000.00
BUREAU OF POSTS.
For the construction, reconstruction, repair, and maintenance of telegraph lines and submarine cables and of
wire less telegraph stations
300,000.00
BUREAU OF COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY.
For the acquisition and installation of a wireless telegraph apparatus on a vessel assigned to the Bureau of
Coast and Geodetic Survey.
15,000.00
BUREAU OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY.
For the construction and reconstruction of lighthouses, buoys, and beacons
30,000.00
For the maintenance, alteration, and repair of lighthouses, buoys, and beacons
30,000.00
UNIVERSITY OF THE PHILIPPINES.

For the construction of a building to be known as Rizal Hall, in accordance with new plans
300,000.00
For the construction of a building for the College of Veterinary Science
For the construction of a building at the College of Agriculture
30,000.00
Total of appropriations made by this section
____________
11,197,900.00
